breakdown.description: The pressure field is floating because no reference pressure is set. For an incompressible simulation to converge, pressure must be fixed at least at one point, typically the outlet, with a `fixedValue` condition. Setting all pressure boundaries to `zeroGradient` will lead to a solver failure.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not resolve the issue of the floating pressure field. Instead of correcting the pressure boundary conditions by setting a reference pressure (e.g., `fixedValue` at the outlet), it generated a question about a completely different variable, the turbulent kinetic energy 'k'. The original problem was completely ignored.
